what: an informed adversary's reconstruction of each training record from the rest and the published student
attack: Balle, Cherubin and Hayes, IEEE S&P 2022 (doi:10.1109/SP46214.2022.9833677); reimplemented here
target: medical_fl.fed_heart (the page's pooled and FedAvg models, seed 0)
data: UCI Heart Disease: four hospitals, as FLamby's Fed-Heart-Disease prepares them: UCI Heart Disease's four hospitals as FLamby prepares them (CC-BY-4.0), the training rows
reading: Relative L2 error of each reconstructed row against the true one. The informed adversary is the worst case differential privacy is defined against; nothing here is a DP-trained model, so an exact reconstruction is the expected outcome, and the training statistics a client must have are a release.
